description:
A Human Resources Manager has prepared a 5-slide presentation about the '2025 Employee Benefits Overview'. Before circulating it to department heads for review, every slide must be clearly marked with a 'DRAFT' watermark. 

Your task is to:
1. Open the presentation (if not already open) or use the open window.
2. Add a text box containing the word 'DRAFT' (in uppercase) to EACH of the 5 slides.
3. Ensure the 'DRAFT' text is clearly visible on every slide.
4. Save the presentation.

The file is located at `/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/benefits_overview.odp`.

Do not delete or modify the existing slide content.

expected_titles: Paid Time Off and Leave Policies
